podcast.body: *Volta* is noted for incorporating a rich array of world music sounds, making it possibly Björk's most globally influenced album. Released during a resurgence of new folk music, it marked a peak in her popularity, followed by an exhausting two-year tour that led to a significant hiatus. "incorpora muchísimos sonidos de músicas del mundo posiblemente se al disco de más enriquecido de músicas del mundo que ha tenido Bjork."

This album's extensive and psychologically demanding tour, which lasted a year and a half, led Björk to take a significant artistic hiatus. The production style of *Volta* contrasts sharply with her later, more unrefined works, marking the end of a heavily produced phase. "Después de esa larguísima gira que se lo prolongó pero a día en año y medio ella decidió un poco tomar su respiro."
